data.narrative:
Evozyne is a Series B-stage biotech company that has raised $144M to date. Valuation was triangulated using two methods against a peer universe of 3 public comparables (RXRX, TEM, ONT.L) and 8 private peers in the Biotech & Health sector, including Colossal Biosciences, Chai Discovery, and New Limit.

Stage-progression analysis, applying a 1.9x step-up multiplier typical of Series B advancement, yields $274M. Peer-median anchoring uses the 3 same-sector, same/adjacent-stage private comparables, which trade at a median valuation of $3.8B, with a range of $3.1B to $10.3B. Public-comp P/S anchoring was not applicable due to absence of revenue disclosure for the target.

The two applicable methods support a triangulated valuation range of $233M to $4.4B, with a median of $2.0B. The wide dispersion reflects meaningful uncertainty around stage trajectory and peer selection. Stage-progression assumes moderate capital step-up discipline; peer-median valuations are heavily influenced by Colossal's $10.3B outlier position, which widens the upper bound. Key uncertainties include target revenue run-rate, time-to-next financing, and whether Evozyne's technology platform commands premium relative to the median peer. A tighter range would require disclosure of financial performance or clarification of competitive positioning within the peer set.
